# Pinned upstream format excerpts

These small text excerpts preserve headers and rows from unmodified
`broadinstitute/ichorCNA` commit
`5bfc03ed854f0e93fe5b624c97c1290fa0053837` for parser-contract tests.
They are not scientific reference assets.

- `GRCh38.centromere.first12.tsv` is the header and first 12 records of
  `inst/extdata/GRCh38.GCA_000001405.2_centromere_acen.txt`, Git blob
  `c5c49a79f88016addc3227d5e93569f7eca9a6eb`.
- `gc_hg38_1000kb.first10.wig` is the fixedStep declaration and first 10 values
  of `inst/extdata/gc_hg38_1000kb.wig`, Git blob
  `5485a08ce3df1b00ef1f5868ae5ca5d0a79bcb0f`.

Source repository: https://github.com/broadinstitute/ichorCNA
